text: 一线城市房价环比连续4个月上涨，房地产市场预期回升 下阶段将继续因城施策控增量、去库存、优供给，推动房地产市场平稳健康运行
text_en: First-tier city home prices rose for a fourth consecutive month, property market expectations improve; next phase to continue city-specific policies to control supply, destock, and optimize supply to promote stable and healthy market operations
